purpose: Record a second independent physical-system occurrence of target 31449 as an estimated apatite lattice energy while preserving the existing experimental H2S spectroscopy P1 and preventing cross-system equality from being mislabeled P2.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Publisher and PubMed records of the same apatite article are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Cross-system numerical equality is not same-system physical relation. A physical value in a different unit/system may be P1 but cannot become P2 without a documented within-system relation.

sources.title: Lattice Energies of Apatites and the Estimation of Delta Hf degrees (PO4 3-, g)
sources.authors: Natalie J. Flora; Claude H. Yoder; H. Donald Brooke Jenkins
sources.note: The article compares experimentally based apatite lattice energies from thermodynamic cycles with Glasser-Jenkins estimates. Its table gives an estimated U_POT of 31449 kJ mol^-1 for Sr10(PO4)6I2.

evidence_updates.permutation_membership: predeclared three-family union; source window 31449 in 13524 family
evidence_updates.claims_boundary: Independent P1 physical-value occurrence only. It is not related physically to the previously established H2S 31449(2) cm^-1 result merely because the integer digits match.

information_updates.finding: Worldshepherd now distinguishes target-level physical multiplicity from P2 relation: one generated integer may correspond to verified physical quantities in multiple unrelated systems and units, but those are separate P1 observations unless a physical relation is independently demonstrated.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Cross-system multiplicity can be counted for null/statistical analysis but is not mechanistic evidence.

information_updates.finding: The apatite work provides a compact validation pattern for material-property estimation: derive reference energies from thermodynamic cycles, estimate from structural volume and ionic strength, quantify deviations, and separate experimentally based from estimated values.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Methodology use is independent of Glob-number evidence.

next_actions: Add a target-level statistic for number of independent physical systems per state, separated by experimental/evaluated/theoretical subtype and unit family.
Do not pool the H2S cm^-1 and apatite kJ mol^-1 31449 observations into a same-system P2 score.
Continue raw-hit accumulation and same-species topology scans across the 208-state union.
Apply unit-aware experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls before interpreting physical-hit multiplicity.
